articles.title: NASA's Artemis III Rocket Assembly Begins: A Crucial Step Toward the Moon
articles.summary: The first solid rocket booster segment for Artemis III has arrived at Kennedy Space Center's Vehicle Assembly Building. These twin boosters will provide 7.2 million pounds of thrust—over 75% of the rocket's liftoff power—for a mission testing lunar landing tech.

articles.title: Newly Discovered 'Hydrogenobody' Organelle Drives Methane Burps in Cows
articles.summary: A tiny organelle inside gut microbes called ciliates produces hydrogen, fueling methane emissions from cows. Researchers cataloged 65 ciliate species and found that fuzzier types correlate with more methane, offering a potential target for reducing greenhouse gases.

articles.title: Citizen Scientists Uncover the Twisty Evolutionary Path of Harvestmen Fatherhood
articles.summary: By combining 30 years of field data with iNaturalist observations, researchers more than doubled documented cases of parental care in harvestmen. They found paternal care evolved repeatedly, sometimes from maternal care, suggesting sexual selection plays a role.
